jobs.title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Full Stack Engineer
About Andela:
At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary:

Andela is transitioning from a world-class talent marketplace into a high-scale, AI-integrated Talent Cloud. As a Staff Full-Stack Engineer on our Internal Product team, you aren't just maintaining a platform; you are architecting the engine that powers the global remote economy. You will own the technical evolution of our proprietary Ruby on Rails ecosystem—solving deep-stack challenges in matching logic, global payments, and automated vetting. This is a role for a "player-coach" who thrives on solving complex problems with elegant code and long-term architectural vision.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • System Architecture: Lead the architectural evolution of Ruby on Rails applications, ensuring they remain performant, maintainable, and secure as they scale.

  • Full-Stack Execution: Deliver high-quality code across the stack, utilizing Ruby on Rails on the backend and modern frontend frameworks (typically React) on the frontend.

  • Performance Optimization: Identify and resolve bottlenecks in the Rails stack (e.g., N+1 queries, indexing, caching strategies) and optimize overall system latency.

  • Technical Leadership: Act as a force multiplier by conducting rigorous code reviews, defining CI/CD standards, and mentoring other engineers in the Andela community.

  • Strategic Partnership: Work closely with stakeholders to translate product vision into technical roadmaps, navigating trade-offs between speed and technical debt.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on Ruby on Rails.

  • Backend Mastery: Expert-level knowledge of Ruby, Rails conventions, and the broader Ruby ecosystem (RSpec, Sidekiq, etc.).

  • Frontend Proficiency: Strong experience with modern JavaScript (React preferred) and CSS/HTML.

  • Data Modeling: Deep understanding of PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design and complex query optimization.

  • DevOps & Infrastructure: Familiarity with deploying and managing Rails apps on AWS, Heroku, or GCP, using Docker and Kubernetes.

  • Communication: Exceptional English skills; ability to influence technical decisions and communicate clearly with distributed teams.

  • Adaptability: A proven track record of thriving in a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Exceptional Leadership:

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

  3. Partnerships & Ecosystem (20%): Identify and cultivate strategic technology (AWS, Databricks, LLM platforms) and SI (Accenture, Deloitte) partnerships; develop co-marketing/co-selling motions; represent Andela in thought leadership.

Success Metrics:

  • 90 Days: Approved solution strategy, sales enablement complete, 2-3 lighthouse customers engaged.

  • 6 Months: First Solution Package (alpha) launched, $500K-$1M pipeline, 3-5 reference case studies, 1-2 partnerships activated.

  • 12 Months: Solution Package matured (beta/final), $2M-$5M revenue, 50-70%+ margins, solution becomes a competitive differentiator.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 8-12 years in solutions consulting, product management, or GTM, with 5+ years in B2B enterprise software/services. Proven 0-to-1 track record (strategy → packaging → commercialization → revenue).

  • Skills: Strategic, Commercial (pricing design), Sales Enablement, Executive Communication, Technical Fluency (moderate depth), and AI/ML Fundamentals (preferred).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Top-tier consulting or boutique firm experience.

  • Product management with full GTM responsibility.

  • Partnerships experience.

  • Startup/scale-up experience.

  • AI solutions expertise (LLM/RAG, ML platforms).

As the Staff Product Designer, you are a visionary leader who shapes how millions of people experience the future of work. You will tackle Andela’s most ambiguous product challenges, working across high-level business strategy and deep user empathy. You aren't just a "maker"; you are a "shaper" who defines the frameworks, logic, and standards that the rest of the design team follows.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Experience Architecture: Lead the design of complex, multi-sided marketplace flows. You will be responsible for the "big picture" logic of our Talent Cloud, ensuring seamless transitions between client hiring needs and talent career growth.

  • Strategic Partnership: Act as a peer to Product and Engineering. You will help define the product roadmap by identifying user-centric opportunities that align with Andela’s commercial goals.

  • Design Systems Governance: While you aren't writing the code, you are the "Source of Truth" for our design language. You will oversee the evolution of our component library to ensure accessibility, consistency, and a world-class aesthetic.

  • Data-Informed Innovation: Use qualitative research and quantitative data to validate your hypotheses. You should be comfortable navigating complex data dashboards to find the "why" behind user behavior.

  • Mentorship & Craft Excellence: Elevate the output of the design team through rigorous design reviews, workshops, and the introduction of new methodologies.

  • Design Mentorship: Act as a "Force Multiplier." You will lead design sprints, conduct high-level critiques, and mentor Senior Designers to help them reach the next level of their careers.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 10+ years in Product Design, with a significant track record of delivering high-impact B2B, SaaS, or Marketplace products.

  • Systems Thinker: You have a deep understanding of how design scales. You can think through edge cases, global localization, and complex state management without needing to see it in code first.

  • Communication: Mastery of the "pitch." You can articulate the ROI of design to non-design stakeholders and build consensus across a global, async organization.

  • Tooling: Expert-level Figma skills, including advanced prototyping, auto-layout, and library management.

  • Product Sense: You think like a Product Manager. You understand trade-offs, technical constraints, and how to ship "Minimum Viable Products" (MVP) to learn fast.

  • The Stack: Experience of Figma paired with professional-grade proficiency in React.js, TypeScript, and CSS-in-JS (or Tailwind).

Additional Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

  • 3+ years in a marketplace, platform, or multi-sided network business model

  • 2+ years managing or mentoring direct reports.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Operations, and commercial teams in a remote or distributed organization.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 12 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you exceptional and hungry to work in a scaling business through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

  • Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • Onedela mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.

About the Role

Sales Development at Andela is more than booking meetings—it's the launchpad for a career in enterprise technology sales. You'll own a territory, build relationships with some of the world's most recognizable companies, and help organizations transform how they build software and AI teams.

From day one, you'll partner closely with experienced Account Executives, own strategic outbound campaigns, and develop the skills to navigate complex enterprise buying committees. You'll be trusted to create pipeline, influence revenue, and become an expert in one of the fastest-growing spaces in technology: AI-powered global talent solutions.

If you're highly competitive, intellectually curious, and motivated by winning, this role offers an accelerated path into enterprise sales.

What You'll Do

You'll play a direct role in Andela's growth by:

  • Own outbound prospecting across a defined territory or strategic account list, creating new pipeline through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.

  • Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to develop account strategies, identify buying signals, and engage multiple stakeholders throughout the buying journey.

  • Build relationships with senior decision makers across Engineering, Technology, Product, HR, and Procurement organizations.

  • Qualify inbound and outbound opportunities through discovery conversations that uncover meaningful business challenges.

  • Support enterprise sales cycles by conducting research, maintaining stakeholder maps, coordinating meetings, and contributing to account plans.

  • Collaborate with Marketing on campaigns, events, and account-based initiatives that generate demand within target accounts.

  • Consistently exceed activity, pipeline, and meeting goals while continuously improving your prospecting approach through experimentation and data.

  • Become an expert in AI, software development, and global talent trends so you can speak credibly with enterprise technology leaders.

What Makes This Role Different

We don't see SDRs as a support function—we see them as future enterprise sellers.

You'll receive hands-on coaching from experienced sales leaders, work alongside high-performing Account Executives, and learn how enterprise technology deals are built from first conversation through closed business.

Whether your goal is becoming an Enterprise AE, leading a sales team, or building your own business one day, you'll develop the commercial skills and business acumen that accelerate your career.

About You

We're looking for someone who is ambitious, coachable, and energized by building relationships.

You might be a great fit if you:

  • Are early in your sales career and excited to build a long-term career in enterprise technology sales.

  • Love competition and enjoy working toward ambitious goals.

  • Take ownership, move quickly, and thrive in environments where you'll be trusted with responsibility.

  • Are naturally curious and ask thoughtful questions to understand business problems.

  • Build rapport easily and communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

  • Are resilient—you see rejection as feedback and remain motivated by long-term success.

  • Enjoy experimenting with new outreach strategies, messaging, and AI tools to improve results.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments where no two days look the same.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of professional experience (internships and sales internships welcomed).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent organization and time management skills.

  • Interest in enterprise technology, AI, or B2B SaaS sales.

  • Experience with CRM or sales engagement tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, or similar is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, adapt to change, and work collaboratively in a remote-first environment.

  • Working and living in the UK

Partner Channel Strategy

  • Stay current on partner ecosystem trends, competitor partner programs, and emerging best practices in B2B channel marketing.

Co-Marketing Programs & Campaigns

  • Design and execute co-marketing campaigns with named partners, including joint demand generation, content collaborations, webinars, digital campaigns, and co-branded events that generate pipeline and drive partner-sourced revenue.

  • Program manage the end-to-end co-marketing process, collaborating with marketing peers across growth, content, design, PR, etc.

  • Build and manage the partner marketing calendar, ensuring a consistent drumbeat of co-marketing activity across priority partners.

  • Manage co-marketing budgets including partner marketing development funds (MDF), ensuring investments are strategically allocated and ROI is tracked and reported.

Partner Enablement

  • Develop and maintain a library of partner-facing marketing assets and collateral, including pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, and campaign toolkits that equip partners to effectively position and sell Andela.

  • Create and deliver partner onboarding and enablement materials that help new partners quickly understand Andela's value proposition, target audience, and key differentiators.

  • Work with the content and brand teams to ensure all partner-facing materials are on-brand, up-to-date, and aligned to Andela's current messaging and positioning.

  • Build scalable systems and processes for partner content distribution and asset management.

Partner Events & Community

  • Own the strategy and execution for partner-focused events — including partner summits, co-hosted roundtables, joint conference presence, and virtual events — designed to deepen partner relationships and generate joint pipeline.

  • Represent Andela at key industry and partner ecosystem events, building relationships and visibility within the partner community.

  • Identify opportunities to build community among Andela's partner network that increase partner engagement, advocacy, and referral activity.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary marketing liaison to the Partnerships team, collaborating closely with the Director of Partnerships on partner acquisition, activation, and growth objectives.

  • Partner with the broader marketing organization — including growth marketing, content, brand, and regional marketing — to bring the full marketing toolkit to bear on partner channel goals.

  • Work with Revenue Operations to ensure partner-sourced pipeline is accurately tracked, attributed, and reported across the funnel.

  • Provide the GTM and product marketing teams with partner insights, feedback, and intelligence to inform Andela's broader go-to-market strategy.

Reporting & Optimization

  • Be accountable to partner marketing KPIs, including partner-sourced pipeline, co-marketing campaign performance, partner engagement, and MDF utilization.

  • Work with marketing and revenue operations to build dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into the health and effectiveness of the partner marketing function.

  • Continuously test, learn, and iterate on program approaches, applying data-driven insights to optimize outcomes over time.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 7–9 years of B2B marketing experience, with a significant portion focused on partner marketing, channel marketing, or alliance marketing roles, ideally within a high-growth technology company.

  • "Demonstrated track record of building and scaling co-marketing programs with technology partners, resellers, or strategic alliances (e.g., Microsoft Azure) from strategy through execution."

  • Experience developing and managing partner enablement programs and content, including working in partner portals.

  • Hands-on experience managing partner marketing development funds (MDF) and co-marketing budgets, including ROI tracking and reporting.

  • Prior experience working closely with a Partnerships or Business Development team to align marketing activity to partner channel revenue goals.

  • Experience in a global, remote-first organization with cross-functional collaboration across time zones.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strategic thinker with a builder's mindset — equally comfortable setting the strategy and rolling up your sleeves to execute.

  • Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to define meaningful metrics, interpret performance data, and translate insights into action.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create compelling partner-facing materials and present confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with a demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with both internal teams and external partners.

Location

  • While Andela is a fully remote organization, this role should be based in either the US or Canada.

  • Some travel required for partner events, conferences, and internal meetings.

  • Experience working with Revenue Operations and Sales Enablement to connect marketing activity to measurable revenue outcomes.

  • Prior experience operating as part of a global, remote-first organization, working effectively across time zones and geographies.

  • Strategic thinker with strong commercial instincts. Able to connect marketing investment to revenue outcomes and make prioritization decisions that reflect a clear understanding of the business.

  • Proven people leader who brings out the best in their team.

  • Highly collaborative and able to operate effectively across functions.

  • Analytically strong, with the ability to define meaningful metrics and translate insights into clear recommendations for leadership.

  • Excellent communicator, both written and verbal, with the ability to present with clarity and confidence to senior stakeholders and to distill complex strategy into focused, actionable plans for your team.

  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams, budgets, and stakeholders simultaneously without losing sight of strategic priorities.

Senior Product Manager — Andela Talent Cloud Platform

About Andela

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries, the majority residing in emerging markets across Africa and Latin America. As one of the world's largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies the flexibility to deploy qualified technologists fast — across Application Development, AI, Cloud & DevOps, and Data Engineering. Andela Talent Cloud (ATC) is our platform for managing the complete global talent lifecycle.

We're at the intersection of two industry transformations — one in staffing and hiring, one in software development — both accelerated by AI. We're looking for a builder who wants to own the platform at the center of it.

About the role

The Andela Talent Cloud platform runs Andela’s business. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of the platform's day-to-day: prioritization, feature development, roadmap, metrics, and maintaining a high quality bar. Andela’s throughput and quality of delivery ride on how well the platform works. You'll also help shape where the product goes next as Andela defines what it means to be relevant in the AI age.

What you'll own

  • Full day-to-day ownership of the ATC platform
    Prioritize needs across our client, operational, and talent users.

  • Fixing immediate pain points
    Close feature gaps that force staff into off-platform workarounds. You’ll have a mandate to bring day-to-day running costs down so that Andela can focus more on business acceleration.

  • Product metrics and analytics
    Build and maintain metrics and funnels to guide product decisions and catch issues before users report them.

  • Deep partnership with operations
    Our operations team uses ATC to run Andela’s business every day. Strong stakeholder relationships are key to uncovering what matters most to move Andela forward.

  • Platform QA and comms processes
    Our amazing engineering team can build and ship fast. You will work with them to maintain a high quality bar and manage communications out to customers.

  • Deep AI integration
    We’re using AI at all levels of Andela – from engineering development to interactive PRDs to integration in user-facing features. You’ll help guide Andela about how to best apply AI to deliver real value, not vaporware or empty marketing claims.

What we're looking for

  • Strong platform ownership in an operations company
    You’ve managed a system where operations teams are the core users and where failures had real business consequences. Experience at a company with at least $50M revenue range is a strong signal.

  • AI-forward disposition
    You don't need a stack of AI projects on your résumé, but you must be deeply curious about where AI is taking the industry, actively hands-on with modern AI tooling in your own workflow, and able to follow and reason about the space as it evolves.

  • Initiative and follow-through
    You see a problem, you own it end-to-end, and you drive it to done without being managed to it. The buck stops with you.

  • 5+ years of product experience
    Product management experience with a clear track record of owning a product and shipping things that drive measurable value. Prior engineering experience is a big plus.

  • Cross-functional leadership
    Relationship-building and the instinct to ask detailed, insightful questions that surface the real requirement beneath a vague ask.

  • US west coast working hours
    At least 6 hours of daily overlap with US West Coast hours (8 AM–2 PM PT).

Nice to have

  • ATS / recruiting / staffing-tech platform experience.

  • Assessment, training, or learning systems experiences.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Claude Design) or agentic workflows.

Job Summary

As the Client Marketing Manager, you will own the full scope of programs that deepen relationships with Andela’s clients, amplify the voice of the customer, and surface market intelligence that directly supports commercial growth. You will operate the Client Advisory Board, lead Voice of the Customer and NPS programs, produce a robust bank of case studies and testimonials, and serve as the connective tissue between Andela’s client base and its broader go-to-market strategy.

You will operate as a strategic partner to Sales, Customer Success, and senior leadership — ensuring that the client perspective informs everything from product positioning to growth strategy. This role reports to the VP, Global Head of Marketing.

Exceptional Leadership

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company — you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • Onedela mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.

Key Responsibilities

Client Marketing Strategy & Programs

  • Own and evolve Andela’s client marketing strategy, developing programs that strengthen client relationships, increase Net Revenue Retention and Expansion Pipeline, and unlock commercial opportunities.

  • Serve as the internal champion for the client perspective — ensuring client voices shape product, marketing, and sales strategy.

  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Product to identify client milestones, success stories, and expansion opportunities worth amplifying.

  • Develop segmented marketing programs, events, and experiences for key client cohorts, supporting upsell, cross-sell, and renewal goals in close partnership with the revenue team.

Client Advisory Board

  • Design, manage, and continuously evolve Andela’s Client Advisory Board (CAB), including membership strategy, meeting cadence, experience design, agenda development, and follow-through on commitments.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with CAB members and ensure the board serves as a meaningful forum for strategic dialogue between Andela leadership and key clients.

  • Document and distribute insights from CAB sessions to relevant internal stakeholders, translating executive client feedback into actionable intelligence for the business.

Voice of the Customer & NPS

  • Own Andela’s Voice of the Customer (VoC) program end-to-end, including survey design, distribution, analysis, and internal reporting.

  • Lead client NPS strategy, tracking, and reporting — translating scores and verbatim feedback into clear, actionable recommendations for the business.

  • Work cross-functionally to close the loop on client feedback, ensuring it reaches the teams best positioned to act on it and that clients feel heard.

  • Establish a regular cadence of client insights reporting to senior leadership, surfacing trends, risks, and opportunities.

Market Insights & Commercial Support

  • Synthesize client intelligence, competitive signals, and market trends to inform GTM strategy, messaging, and sales conversations.

  • Collaborate with the External Relations team to develop and maintain a library of market insights that equip the commercial team to engage clients and prospects more effectively.

  • Partner with product marketing and sales to ensure client insights are reflected in positioning, proposals, and client-facing materials.

  • Serve as a strategic resource for the VP of Marketing and commercial leadership, providing a grounded, evidence-based view of the market as seen through the lens of Andela’s client base.

  • Work with sales leaders to include market insights and Andela research in key client QBR presentations - looking to move beyond project status updates to forward-thinking planning.

Win/Loss Analysis

  • Own Andela’s win/loss analysis program — designing the methodology, conducting or managing interviews, and synthesizing findings into clear, prioritized recommendations.

  • Share win/loss insights regularly with sales leadership, product, and marketing to inform strategy, improve competitive positioning, and increase win rates.

  • Identify patterns across wins and losses to surface systemic issues or opportunities, going beyond individual deal narratives to drive structural improvements.

Client Advocacy & Storytelling

  • Build and maintain a robust, up-to-date bank of client testimonials, case studies, and success stories spanning industries, geographies, and use cases.

  • Proactively identify clients who are strong candidates for advocacy activities, including speaking engagements, press opportunities, reference calls, and co-marketing initiatives.

  • Manage Andela’s client awards nomination program — researching, writing, and submitting compelling nominations to industry awards on behalf of Andela’s clients and in recognition of client partnerships.

  • Collaborate with content, PR, and brand teams to bring client stories to life across channels like the website and sales decks to events and social media.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 3 years in a client marketing, customer marketing, or customer advocacy role.

  • Proven experience managing or contributing to a Client Advisory Board or similar executive client engagement program.

  • Demonstrated track record of running Voice of the Customer and/or NPS programs with measurable business impact.

  • Experience producing client case studies, testimonials, and customer advocacy content at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with win/loss analysis programs, including interview design, facilitation, and synthesis.

  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and senior leadership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience at a high-growth technology or services company strongly preferred; experience in the talent, workforce, or staffing industry is a plus.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Exceptional storytelling and written communication skills.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to design surveys, interpret data, and present findings clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • High emotional intelligence and relationship-building skills — experienced at building trust with executive-level clients.

  • Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to run multiple programs simultaneously.

  • A proactive, owner mentality — you identify gaps and close them, and you bring others along with you.

Location

  • While Andela is a fully remote organization, this role should be based in the US or UK.

  • Some travel required for Client Advisory Board events, client visits, and industry conferences.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary:

The Director of FP&A is a strategic partner responsible for shaping how Andela plans, invests, and makes decisions as we scale. This role blends analytical rigor, strong business judgment, and clear storytelling to help the executive team navigate complexity and tradeoffs with confidence.

You will own the company’s financial planning engine end-to-end and operate as a deeply embedded partner to leaders across the company. Success in this role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity, exercises strong judgment, and takes full ownership of outcomes. This is a role for a steady, proactive operator who sees around corners and brings clarity to complex decisions.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company, you do not need to manage people to be a leader at Andela! Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • Onedela mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Cultivator: You enrich, you push, you make others grow. It comes from the heart, because you care.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this without micromanaging, empowering your team while actively engaging in important details.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the corporate financial model, including the full three-statement build (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) and the scenario planning architecture layered on top of it.

  • Leadall end-to-end planning cycles (annual operating plan, monthly rolling forecasts, long-range plan), from creating the process to building templates through executive review and Board approval

  • Own the monthly business review to diagnose financial health of the business (budget vs actual analysis, variance drivers, and forward-looking implications)

  • Build capital allocation and investment frameworks to build business cases for growth initiatives, evaluate experiments, and tradeoffs with financial discipline

  • Build unit economics, cohort, and scenario analysis to identify optimization opportunities and inform strategic decisions

  • Partner with GTM, Data, and RevOps on revenue and pipeline forecasting; proactively identify risks and opportunities to achieving company targets

  • Prepare clear, investor-ready narratives that connect financial performance, operating drivers, and forward-looking strategy

  • Manage one Finance Business Partner

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience across corporate finance, FP&A, strategic finance, or related roles, including at least 5 years in corporate/strategic finance at a high-growth B2B technology or SaaS company

  • 2+ years of people management experience, building and leading high-performing teams

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; experience with modern FP&A tools

  • Exceptional storyteller, capable of distilling complex analyses into strategic insights for executive and board audiences with clarity and precision; ability to influence across all levels without direct authority

  • A collaborative, proactive, curious, and growth mindset with a passion for problem solving and driving impact

  • Systems thinker who connects financial drivers to business strategy

This role is probably not for you if your recent years of experience have been spent:

  • As a business partner to one function inside a large organization

  • As primarily a coach (i.e. people manager, reviewer of your team’s work product) versus player or player/coach (as much in the details and weeds as you are in the strategy)

  • Optimizing inherited, mature processes versus first-principles building
